question: What ash and fixed carbon contents, on an air-dried basis, did the sewage sludge used for carbide slag-assisted steam gasification have?
rendered: The sewage sludge used for carbide slag-assisted steam gasification had an ash content of 43.62 wt % and a fixed carbon content of 12.39 wt %.
